info.title: bac2dac command line tool
info.description: Command line tool that rewrites a SQL Server .bacpac into a .dacpac without a SQL Server instance and without SqlPackage. Install it as a .NET tool and run "dotnet bac2dac database.bacpac". Based on the observed layout of the packages rather than on documented behaviour.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Rewrites a .bacpac (schema + data) into a .dacpac (schema only).

options.name: --output
options.description: Same as the positional output argument.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Print nothing unless something goes wrong.

arguments.name: OUTPUTDACPAC
arguments.description:
Where to write the result. Defaults to the input
path with the extension replaced by .dacpac.
